subject: Air freight quote: MUC to CAI
body:
Hi,

Could you quote the cheapest air freight option for textile samples from MUC to CAI (Cairo, EG)? The cargo is ready on 2026-11-24, and we’ll deliver it to MUC ourselves.

Lot 1: 9 pieces, 345 kg gross, 0.58 cbm
Lot 2: 2 pieces, 141 kg gross, 2.04 cbm

Please quote one all-in price in EUR for both lots shipping together as a single consignment under one air waybill.

Mira Petersen
Nordlicht Audio
